name: Image Link Attributes
description: Extends the core image field link to add custom class, target and rel attributes to the generated anchor.
project_description:
About

The Image Link Attributes module extends Drupal's default image field so that when an image field is set to link to its file or its content, additional attributes can be applied to the generated anchor: Target (target=xxx), Class (class=xxx) and Relationship (rel=xxx, e.g. rel="lightbox-series"). It works with both image fields (formatter 'image') and responsive image fields (formatter 'responsive_image').

Usage

Install the module, then navigate to the Manage display page of the bundle holding the image field. When the image is set to link to content or file, additional third-party settings become available under the field's formatter settings so you can enable custom attributes and set their values.

Link to an Image Style variant

From version 8.x-1.8 and newer, the linked image can point at an Image Style variant instead of the original file. Enable the 'Link to alternate Image Style' checkbox on the Manage display settings form and pick the image style the field should link to.
